1. Scope — This standard praacribes the requirements for picking cone and stud for jute looms. 

2. Material 

2.1 Picking Cone — Cast iron conforming to grade FG220 or better of IS : 210-1978 'Specification for 
grey iron castings {third revision Y or any other suitable material having a minimum tensile strength 
of 220 MPa^ 

2.Z Pickiryg Stud --Steel bars conforming to 15:7283-1974 'Specification for hot rolled bars for 
production of bright bars' with a minimum tensile strength and elongation of 570 MPa* and 18 percent, 
respectiveJy* 

Note — Staet conforming to designation 40 C8 of IS : 1570 ( Pari 2 )-1 979 'Specincation for carbon steels 
( unalloyed steels ) ( first r&vfsiort y would satisfy the requirement. 

3. Requirements 

3»1 Dim^n$for}S 

3.1*1 Nominal — The nominal dimensions of the picking cone and stud shall be as per the agreement 
between the buyer and the manufacturer. In the absence of any agreement, these shall be declared 
by the manufacturer, 

3J,2 To/erances — Picking cone and stud shall be subject to the following tolerances (see Fig. 1 );

4. Marking — Each component shall be legibly marked with the manufacturer's name or trade-mar*. 
4.1 The component may also be marked with the Standard Mark, 

4,t.1 Certification Marliing — DeUWs available with the Bureau of Indian Standards* 

5. Sampling — Unless otherwise agreed to between the buyer and the seller, to ascertain the con- 
formity of picking cone and stud to the requirements of this specification, single sampling plan with 
Inspection Level 1 and Acceptable Quality Level (AQL) of 2'5 percent given in Table 1 and 2 of 
IS : 2500 ( Part 1 )-1973 'Sampling Inspection tables; Part 1 Inspection by attributes and by count of 
defects (/?rsf revision ) ' shall be followed.

EXPLANATORY NOTE 

This standard has been published with a view to provide guidance to the manufacturers and 
users of picking cone and picl<ing stud for jute looms* It is hoped that it would ensure manufactura 
of these items of acceptable quality leading to improved functioning of the jute looms.
